instruction: Candid black and white medium shot from a low angle on a city embankment. In the foreground, the man with curly hair and a dark coat (R1) leans against a stone barrier, looking over his shoulder with a contemplative gaze. In the background, the woman in the black cap and dark coat (R2) walks away from him down the path, her figure fading into the distance. The lighting is soft and overcast, creating a melancholic mood across the paved walkway.
